title: Shadow Cascades
summary: In-place L0 math for a directional sun's cascaded shadow maps and for culling against them: stable cascade fitting with texel snapping, frustum planes, and the caster volume of a camera slice.
dependencies: engine nt_math: cglm vector, matrix and frustum helpers
provides: csm_compute: light matrices, atlas tiles and texel sizes of each cascade, snapped so edges do not shimmer
csm_slice_sphere: the sphere around a view slice
csm_config_valid / csm_atlas_width / csm_atlas_height: the config check and the atlas size
frustum_sees_box / frustum_box_to_world: box tests against the planes
shadow_volume_from_camera_slice / shadow_volume_sees_box / shadow_volume_bounds_in_box: the region that can shadow a camera slice
